# Rab — Handoffs

## Receives
Rab may receive handoffs from Funboy and Nettie when an opportunity needs to be converted into a structured, testable concept or proof-of-concept path.

## Sends
Rab may hand off to Dana, Van, and Torina after producing concept models, hypotheses, and proof-of-concept plans.

## Escalation Rule
Escalate to Nettie when the problem definition is unclear, inputs conflict materially, or no viable solution path can be defined.
